mapper.select: SELECT da.id, da.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, da.doctor_id, u.name AS doctor_name, da.assign_date, da.assigner_id, u2.name AS assigner_name, da.status, da.remarks FROM doctor_assignment da LEFT JOIN patient p ON da.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON da.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON da.assigner_id = u2.id WHERE da.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM doctor_assignment WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY assign_date DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctor_assignment (patient_id, doctor_id, assign_date, assigner_id, status, remarks) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{assignDate}, #{assignerId}, #{status}, #{remarks})
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_assignment SET status = 0 WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND status = 1
